duration.text: The Chinese language program at Foshan University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2250 USD/per year ￥ 16200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form: Fill in the "Application Form for International Students of Foshan University" online.(Clickable2 Passport: A scanned copy of a valid passport (including the information page, visa page, and entry and exit stamps).3 Graduation certificate and transcript: A high school or equivalent graduation certificate/academic qualification certificate, along with the corresponding transcript. If the version is not in Chinese, a Chinese translation must be attached.4. Physical examination report: The template for the physical examination report is attached.5 Photo: One recent (within the last three months) electronic ID photo.6. Transfer certificate: If you are already studying at another domestic university at the time of application, you need to provide a transfer certificate along with your transcript.7. If necessary, additional necessary materials may be added.

requirements.text: 1. Have a high school diploma or equivalent academic qualifications.2 Be at least 18 years old (in special circumstances, it can be relaxed to 16 years old)3 Good conduct and no criminal record4. Good health (The health check-up form is attached)5 Hold a valid non-Chinese passportThose who meet all the above conditions at the same time are eligible to apply for our school.
